start.title: Write your business code today.
start.subtitle: Authentication, workspaces, invitations, and access control are already connected. Focus on the features that make your product yours.
start.foundation: Less setup. More of your product.
start.workspaceBody: Give your team a shared space. Invite people and choose who can manage it.
start.profileBody: Update your name, protect your account, and choose your language and appearance.
start.authBody: Email verification, password recovery, and protected sessions.
start.teamBody: Separate memberships with owner, administrator, and member access.
start.languagesBody: Switch languages and use a layout that follows your reading direction.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.subtitle: A shared space for each team. Switch between your workspaces without mixing memberships.
workspaces.emptyBody: Create one below, or open an invitation link from your team.
workspaces.createBody: You will be the owner. Add your teammates when you are ready.
workspaces.name: Workspace name
workspaces.detailBody: Manage this workspace and the people who can access it.
workspaces.rolesHint: Owners manage roles. Administrators invite members. Members belong to this workspace only.
workspaces.removeConfirm: Remove {{email}} from this workspace? They will lose access.
workspaces.inviteBody: Create a private link for one email address. It expires in 7 days and must be accepted by that account.
workspaces.shareLink: Share this link privately with the invited person. No email has been sent. Creating another link invalidates their previous invitation.
workspaces.joinBody: Accept this invitation using the account shown below. Your email must match the invited address. If you use a different account, sign out and reopen this link.
